explanation: The biscuit packet has a glossy printed cellophane/plastic wrapper over cardboard. The material is non-metallic (plastic and cardboard), so metallic should be very low at 0.0. The surface appears somewhat glossy due to the cellophane wrapping, but with visible wrinkles and creases that add some roughness. A roughness value around 0.35-0.4 captures the semi-glossy nature of printed plastic packaging with some surface irregularities.
